free_tier.stated: no free tier; Aydin VPS x16 is USD 10.99 a month on the monthly cycle and USD 8.79 a month on the annual cycle for 6 cores, 16 GB of RAM and 120 GB of SSD, with unlimited bandwidth on a 1 Gbps port and no setup fee printed

retention.stated: the disk persists while the plan is paid; the page states no deletion clock

egress.terms: unlimited bandwidth on a 1 Gbps port under a fair-use policy, stated on the configurator; no byte quota and no overage price is printed

interface_detail: full administrator access over RDP on a dedicated IPv4; the WHMCS control panel starts, stops, reinstalls and opens a console, and the operating-system select lists Windows Server 2012R2, 2019 and 2022 among the images
tooling: any RDP client; the Rabisu panel for reinstall and console
chaining: the cheapest 16 GB machine whose operating-system list offers Windows at no printed surcharge, so it is the row a reader reaches for first. What it cannot carry is the licence claim: the machine is cheap and documented, the licence is unresolved, and the two are different facts.
limits_note: the page calls the traffic unlimited and adds a fair-use clause; it prints no byte number, no monthly cap and no throttle rate. The port is shared, so the 1 Gbps figure is a ceiling and not a guarantee. The monthly cycle is the default: the monthly radio carries checked in the served HTML, and the four cycles print monthly 10.99, quarterly 9.89, semi-annual 9.34 and annual 8.79, each against the 10.99 reference.
binding_note: the shared 1 Gbps port and the unstated fair-use threshold decide sustained throughput; the RAM and disk shapes are not the constraint at this price.

identity_cost.detail: an account and a payment method at order; the configurator's order summary prints no total and the add-to-cart POST was not completed

reliability_note: no reliability event observed the configurator renders a 'please correct the following errors' banner because the add-to-cart POST was not completed, and the 'FREE Setup Fee' text on the page belongs to a cross-sell block rather than to this plan.
confidence_note: the machine is documented: the shape, all four cycle rates, the monthly default, the Windows Server images in the operating-system select and the absence of a setup fee are read from the live configurator on 2026-10-26. The licence inclusion is reported and not documented, which is what drags the record down a rung: the sentence 'all Windows VPS plans include a genuine Windows Server license' was carried by an earlier reader from https://www.rabisu.com/vps-windows, that path now returns 404, and the configurator, the home page and the knowledgebase contain zero occurrences of licen, license or genuine. A cart with a licence line, or a vendor statement on a live path, moves this record back to documented.

notes: Two claims were separated here on 2026-10-26. The machine is documented and unchanged: USD 10.99 monthly, USD 8.79 annual, 6 cores, 16 GB, 120 GB SSD, monthly cycle as the default, Windows 2012R2, 2019 and 2022 in the OS list at no printed surcharge, no setup fee. The record's url moved from the dead /vps-windows path to the live configurator, which is the page every number above comes from. The annual cycle needs USD 105.48 up front. Region upgrades move the price: on the monthly cycle London, Dublin, Falkenstein, New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas and Beauharnois add USD 5.22, Sydney, Singapore and Hong Kong add USD 8.72, and Karachi adds USD 22.12; the annual cycle scales those to USD 4.18, USD 6.98 and USD 17.70.
